reason: "to get out of bed" is a restatement of the existing "to get up" / 起床; the evidence sentence 毎朝七時に起きます is exactly that sense.

"to learn of" is the inceptive reading of "to know" (知りました = came to know) — an aspect of the verb form, not a separate lexical sense. 知道 covers 得知 in Chinese too, and a learner reading "to know" beside 新聞で知りました understands it.
"for a short time" is "a little" applied to a duration; 稍微/一点点 already yield 稍等一下 for ちょっと待ってください. Transparent from the current line.
"text"/"passage" sits inside the existing "sentence, article" / 文章・句子 range; a learner reading the current line beside この文章を読んでください understands it.
"on top of" is already carried by 上面 (桌子上面) and by "above"; テーブルの上にあります is fully readable from the current line.

"to turn off" is transitive — that is 消す (けす), the transitive partner, not 消える (きえる), which is intransitive. The evidence sentence 電気が消えました is the intransitive "went out", already covered by "to go out"/熄滅. Adding this gloss would teach 電気を消える.
"day off" is the existing "rest, vacation" / 休息・假期 applied to a company day; 会社が休みです is readable from the current line.
"visit to someone who is ill" is a word-for-word restatement of "visiting ill person" / 探望(病人).
"in that way or manner" is the existing "like that" / 那样 spelled out; ああやって is exactly that.
Homophone: "most, to the highest degree" is 最も (superlative adverb, as in 日本でもっとも高い山). The entry's glosses "quite right / however" are 尤も, a different word sharing the reading もっとも.
